aboutText: We offer rooms and apartments for short or extended stays, a restaurant and bar for daily service, a wellness area, and spaces for meetings and events. The hotel is run as a local family business, with personal involvement and on-the-spot decisions. We provide a central location with easy access, integrated services (accommodation, restaurant, wellness, events), a constant standard of cleanliness and safety, and flexibility for corporate, groups, and private events.

spaText: A space dedicated to disconnection, sheltered from the fast pace of the city. Regardless of the season, we await you with a heated indoor pool and dry sauna, completing the experience of a restful stay.
restaurantText: Our menu is a careful selection of classic dishes and modern reinterpretations, cooked with local ingredients and a lot of patience. We emphasize freshness and the joy of sharing a meal with someone you love.
eventsText: Our conference rooms are configurable according to the number of participants and are equipped with the necessary equipment for productive meetings or discreet private events.

termsAcceptance: By using the site and/or submitting a booking request, you confirm that you have read and accept this document.
termsSection1Title: 1) Purpose of the Site. General Information
termsSection1Content:
The site presents the services offered by Hotel Maxim (accommodation, restaurant & bar, wellness, meeting/conference rooms) and allows the submission of booking requests/offers.

S.C. MAXIM S.A. reserves the right to update the information on the site, including commercial and operational policies, without prior notice.
termsSection2Content:
2.1 How to Book

Bookings can be submitted through the forms available on the site or by direct contact (phone/e-mail). The booking confirmation is sent by the hotel, depending on availability.

2.2 Data Required at Check-in

Accommodation is provided by filling out the arrival notification form, based on the identity document, in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

2.3 Arrivals & Departures

  • Check-in: starting from 14:00
  • Check-out: until 12:00
  • Late check-out: possible depending on availability, with a fee applicable according to hotel practice.
termsSection3Content:
3.1 Rates displayed on the site (RON/night)

Accommodation rates are expressed in RON/night. VAT is included in the room rate.

  • Standard Single – 300 RON
  • Deluxe Single – 330 RON
  • Standard Double – 390 RON
  • Deluxe Double – 420 RON
  • Triple (Deluxe) – 550 RON
  • Apartment – 500–550 RON

3.2 Local tax / tourist promotion tax – 3%

A local tax of 3% is applied to the rates above. This is paid separately. According to local regulations, the tourist promotion tax is calculated by applying a rate of 3% to the accommodation rate exclusive of VAT, and is collected by the accommodation unit.

3.3 What is included in the accommodation rate

Standard rates include (where mentioned on the site): internet, parking (subject to availability), access to the fitness room, and access to the swimming pool.

3.4 Rate Adjustments

Depending on the occupancy rate and the type of request (leisure, corporate, events), the hotel may apply different rates/commercial conditions, communicated in the offer/confirmation sent to the client.
termsSection4Content:
Accepted methods: cash (RON), card (Visa/Mastercard/Maestro/American Express), and bank transfer.

Payment rules:

  • payment is made in advance or within a maximum of 3 days of accommodation;
  • for long-stays, payment is made in advance or every 3 days;
  • for phone/fax bookings without card details, an advance payment may be required to guarantee the booking.
termsSection5Content:
Cancellations are made by contacting the reception.

  • Bookings up to 2 rooms: no penalty if cancellation is made at least 3 days in advance; otherwise, the penalty may be the equivalent of the first night.
  • Bookings of 2+ rooms: cancellation must be made at least 10 days before the arrival date.
  • Groups: conditions are communicated on request, depending on the number of rooms/services.
termsSection6Title: 6) Policy for Children and Extra Beds
termsSection6Content:
• Children up to 7 years: free accommodation and breakfast.
  • Children 7–14 years: free accommodation; breakfast 30 RON/child.
  • Over 14 years: considered adults.

Extra beds:

  • extra bed for children under 2 years: 70 RON
  • normal extra bed: 90 RON
termsSection7Content:
7.1 Visitors

Visitors in the room between 08:00–22:00, at no extra cost. Between 22:00–08:00, visitors must be registered at the reception and may pay the rate difference, according to hotel rules.

7.2 Pets

General rule: accommodation with animals/birds is not allowed. Exceptions: only with the hotel's consent and with sanitary/vaccination documents; a fee may apply (mentioned as 50% of the value charged for one person).
termsSection8Content:
The hotel uses electronic systems to monitor access; public spaces are under video surveillance. It is recommended to use the in-room safe to store valuables.

Parking is available for free, subject to availability, without dedicated security; it is recommended to avoid leaving items in plain sight.

The hotel's liability does not extend to vehicles or their contents.
termsSection9Content: The hotel reserves the right to refuse accommodation/service in the restaurant in situations that affect the safety, order, or comfort of other guests or the image of the unit.
termsSection10Content: The processing of personal data (e.g., name, phone, e-mail, booking data) is done for the administration of bookings and hotel services. Full details are available in the Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy published on the site.
termsSection11Content: For accommodation services on a specific date/period, the legislation provides exceptions to the right of withdrawal (14 days) applicable to other distance contracts.
termsSection12Content: Any complaint is first sent to the Hotel (phone/e-mail). Consumers can use the Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) mechanisms through ANPC. The European ODR platform was closed starting July 20, 2025.
termsSection13Content: Any dispute will be settled amicably; in the absence of a solution, the dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the competent courts in Bihor.

cookiePolicySection1Content: Cookies are small files saved in your browser/device when you visit a website. Some are strictly necessary for functionality, while others (analytics/marketing) are set only with your consent.
cookiePolicySection2Title: 2) What technologies do we use on the site?
cookiePolicySection2Content:
On this site, we may use:
  • Google Tag Manager (GTM) – for tag management. (GTM itself should not 'track', but tags launched through it can set cookies/identifiers.)
  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4) – traffic analysis, only with consent.
  • Google Ads – conversions/remarketing, only with consent.
  • Meta Pixel (Facebook/Instagram) – conversions/remarketing, only with consent.
  • Google Maps embed – third-party content (iframe). Loading it may generate Google cookies; we recommend 'click-to-load' based on consent.
  • Chat widget – the exact provider determines the cookies (details below).
cookiePolicySection3Content:
Options in the banner

  • Accept all
  • Reject non-essential
  • Customize (by categories)

Operating Rules

  • Analytical and Marketing cookies are disabled by default and are activated only upon your choice.
  • Consent must be free, specific, informed, and unambiguous, and withdrawal must be as easy as giving it.
  • You can change your options at any time from the 'Cookie Settings' link in the footer.
cookiePolicySection4Content:
4.1 Strictly Necessary (ON, no option)

Required for the site's operation and security (e.g., consent preferences, protection, technical functions). These are not used for advertising.

Examples (may vary depending on CMP/implementation):

  • consent preference storage cookie (e.g., consent_state / similar)
  • technical session cookies

4.2 Preferences (Functional) (OFF by default)

Remembers settings (e.g., language) or optional functions (e.g., chat, if configured as functional).

4.3 Analytics (Measurement) (OFF by default)

Helps understand site usage and make improvements.

  • Provider: Google Analytics 4
  • Main GA4 Cookies:
    • _ga – 2 years – distinguishes users
    • _ga_<container-id> – 2 years – persists session state

Important technical note: browsers can limit the effective duration of first-party cookies (e.g., max. ~400 days in certain conditions).

4.4 Marketing (Advertising & remarketing) (OFF by default)

Used for measuring conversions, remarketing, and evaluating campaign effectiveness. Activated only with consent.

4.4.1 Google Ads (via GTM / Google tag)

Relevant cookies (most common in Ads + conversions/remarketing implementations; the full list depends on configuration):

  • _gcl_au – 90 days – attribution/conversions (Ads)
  • _gcl_aw – 90 days – Google Ads conversion attribution
  • _gcl_dc – 90 days – attribution/remarketing (DV360/CM/Ads)
  • IDE – 13 months (EEA/UK) – DoubleClick advertising cookie
  • test_cookie – 15 minutes – checks cookie support (DoubleClick)
4.4.2 Meta Pixel (Facebook/Instagram)

Common cookies:

  • _fbp – 3 months – browser identification for ads/attribution
  • fr – 3 months – ad delivery/retargeting (Meta)

If the user is logged into the Meta ecosystem, other Meta cookies may appear (depending on the context). For transparency, you mention the provider and the type of processing, and the cookie inventory is generated from the CMP scan.
cookiePolicySection5Content:
Google Maps embed (iframe) can set Google cookies when loaded (e.g., NID, and Google also uses SOCS for the state of cookie options across Google services).
Compliance recommendation (practice):
  • display a placeholder ('The map is disabled until you accept Marketing/Third-party content cookies') + 'Activate map' button;
  • on click, either ask for consent for the relevant category or load the map only after consent.
cookiePolicySection6Content:
The chat can set Functional cookies (e.g., maintain the chat session) or, in some cases, may include tracking/analytics.
What to complete in the UI (after you tell me the exact provider: Intercom / Crisp / Tawk.to / LiveChat / Zendesk etc.):
  • Cookie Name
  • Provider
  • Purpose (e.g., maintains session, prevents spam, attaches conversation)
  • Duration

Until then, the inventory displays 'Chat widget – third-party provider – functional cookies (details to be completed)'.
cookiePolicySection7Content: Your consent preference is remembered, and you may be asked to reconfirm it periodically (e.g., every 6–12 months, depending on the CMP policy).
cookiePolicyMarketingContent:
A) What data may be processed for marketing

Depending on your choices and interactions, we may process:

  • Contact details (name, email, phone) – only if you submit them via forms and check the marketing box (where applicable).
  • Online identifiers / events (e.g., pages visited, conversions, clicks) – only if you accept Analytics/Marketing cookies.

B) Marketing Purposes (explicit)

  • sending communications about offers/packages (only on an opt-in basis);
  • measuring campaign performance (Ads/Meta);
  • remarketing to users who have interacted with the site (Ads/Meta).

C) Legal Basis

  • Consent for Analytics/Marketing cookies and for direct marketing (newsletter/offers).
  • Withdrawal of consent must be possible at any time and easily.

D) How to give your consent (recommended UI in forms)

Separate checkboxes (unchecked):

  • [ ] I want to receive offers and marketing communications from Hotel Maxim (MAXIM S.A.) by email/SMS/phone.
    I can withdraw my consent at any time (unsubscribe / request at reception).

For tracking (cookie banner):

  • Accept/Reject/Customize + Cookie Settings in the footer.

E) How to withdraw your consent

  • from the footer: Cookie Settings (for Analytics/Marketing);
  • from the email: Unsubscribe (if you send a newsletter);
  • direct request: rezervari@hotel-maxim.ro.

F) Recipients / providers

We may use providers (processors) for:

  • hosting / maintenance,
  • analytics (Google),
  • advertising (Google/Meta),
  • chat (the widget's provider).

Details are listed in the 'Cookie Inventory' and in the Privacy Policy.
